name: iteration5_fixed_quality_and_marginal_witnesses
marginal_windows: deterministic early, middle, late contiguous and evenly spaced physical-mode windows; deduplicate before allocating alpha
split: first pilot_size rows choose a positive-discrepancy event; all remaining rows evaluate it; no held-out sign reversal

jiuzhang1.scope: New independently seeded generation-only Frugal batch with an atomic checkpoint. The failed iteration4 v1 density audit remains unchanged. This is the published JZ1 Gaussian model, not raw hardware samples or a reproduction of the Frugal JZ2/JZ3 GPU study.

failure_policy: one fixed batch per comparison; preserve failure, no retries, no K reduction, no postselection; unused confidence budgets are not reassigned
quality_scope: Specified zero-mean Gaussian threshold target. Marginal witnesses can reject full-law closeness but cannot accept it. Statistical bounds assume iid attempts and accurate floating-point target probabilities.
